title: Finite local presentations under the common coefficient encoding
statement: For a finite discrete commutative ring B, choose e and G as in [def-weil-pbc-common-finite-discrete-encoding]. For every scheme T and every constructible internal module M over the continuous-function coefficient ring, the ordinary module-valued pro-etale sheaf E_T.inverse(M) is intrinsically constructible: it has a finite stratification whose restrictions admit pro-etale covers by constant finite ULift B-modules. No characteristic, nonzero-ring, or nonempty-scheme assumption is required.

source.place: Proposition 5.3.2 and Lemmas 5.4.1 and 5.4.3; Stacks Project Tag 09AK

proof.text: Keep the finite stratification in the internal constructibility witness and apply the one-stratum result to each local finite-presentation hypothesis.
These finite locally constant ordinary restrictions, on the same stratification, are exactly the intrinsic constructibility witness.

proof_origin.note: D2: retain the given stratification; transport finite presentations, apply the proved finite locally constant cokernel theorem via etale comparison, and bind covering families. The inverse-image comparison is proved from the remaining scalar coefficient-unit compatibility on sections.

theorem finiteDiscreteCoefficient_constructible [DiscreteTopology B] [Finite B]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (M : FiniteDiscreteInternalModules B T)
    (hM : IsConstructibleModuleObject
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} B) T) M) :
    ProEtale.IsConstructible (ULift.{u + 1} B)
      ((finiteDiscreteCoefficientEquivalence B eR G hG T).inverse.obj M)
